name: DeepKeys - Shortcuts for DeepSeek
short_description: A User-friendly Browser Extension for navigating Deep-Seek faster with custom shortcuts.
description: DeepKeys is a browser extension designed to supercharge your DeepSeek experience with intuitive keyboard shortcuts, allowing you to navigate conversations effortlessly. No more tedious scrolling or manual copying, DeepKeys streamlines your workflow, making interaction with DeepSeek faster and more efficient.
